question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Pretence
solution: The correct answer is '**Reality**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Pretence**' is '**Reality**'. • **Pretence**: an action that makes people believe something that is not true. (प्रदर्शन, ढोंग, दिखावा) • *Example: She was unable to keep up the **pretence** that she loved him.* • **Reality**: the way life really is, not the way it may appear to be or how you would like it to be. [वास्‍तविकता, यथार्थ (जीवन जैसा है वैसा, न कि जैसा वह लग सकता है या जैसा हमें पसंद है)] • *Example: I enjoyed my holiday, but now it’s back to **reality**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Reality.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Impotence**: the inability of a man to achieve an erection or orgasm. (नपुंसकता, शक्तिहीनता) • **Arrogance**: the quality of being arrogant. (अहंकारी होने का गुण) • **Intolerance**: unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own. (असहिष्‍णुता, असहनशीलता) 3b:Ta00, The incorrectly spelt word is '**Repitetion**'.
